collection.description: Two neighbors invite a quiet villager to share their meal.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two neighbors invite (name1), a quiet villager, to share their meal. The conversation is ordinary, which is exactly what feels comforting.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two neighbors invite (name1), a quiet villager, to share their meal. A small invitation changes the mood of the whole afternoon.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two neighbors invite (name1), a quiet villager, to share their meal. (Name1) enjoys the company and also looks forward to time alone.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two neighbors invite (name1), a quiet villager, to share their meal. Someone remembers an old joke, and the group starts laughing again.
